label: false_positive
rationale: The image (decoded from the snapshot) is the INSS / Previdência logo: green and gold arcs around a blue tiled globe. It is the only content of a link in the 'Galeria de aplicativos' that opens the Meu INSS app entry. For a functional logo like this, alt text that names the app ('Meu INSS - Central de Serviços') is exactly what 1.1.1 needs. The suggested 'Logotipo do Meu INSS' describes how it looks rather than what it does, which is worse. The image shows what the alt names.

label: false_positive
rationale: This is the home page of the GOV.BR portal (I confirmed live that <title> is 'GOV.BR'). A home page's topic is the site itself, so a title naming the site identifies the page and meets 2.4.2. WCAG does not require a tagline. The patch only adds 'Serviços e Informações do Brasil', which makes the title wordier, not compliant.

The generic 'Categorias' title is a property of the destination page, not a link-purpose failure. The patch only drops the description and does not fix the alleged mismatch. A longer descriptive link name does not fail 2.4.4.
